pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 7.3.1: PERSONAL AND POSSESSIVE PRONOUNS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Grammar in Use 7.3.1: Personal and possessive pronouns

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 7.3.1: Personal and possessive pronouns. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should we avoid unnecessary repetition?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use personal and possessive pronouns in sentences appropriately

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. use personal and possessive pronouns in sentences appropriately
   In simple words: practise until you can use personal and possessive pronouns in sentences appropriately. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 7.3.1: Personal and possessive pronouns using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 7.3.1: Personal and possessive pronouns in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 7.3.1: Personal and possessive pronouns to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 7.3.1: Personal and possessive pronouns.
4. Show that you can: use personal and possessive pronouns in sentences appropriately

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 7.3.1: Personal and possessive pronouns using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 7.3.1: Personal and possessive pronouns important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Construct sentences using personal pronouns,
2. Write a paragraph using possessive pronouns,
3. Construct sentences using personal pronouns from substitution and completion tables,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. use personal and possessive pronouns in sentences appropriately

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
